task.title: Add a family with children
task.shortdesc: Join two partners, record their marriage and add their children.

prereq.p: Add both partners first. shows how.

step.cmd: Open one of the partners, scroll down and choose .

info.p: A person who is not in a family yet shows this button under .

stepresult.p: A form opens. The person you came from is already in .

step.cmd: Select the box and type the start of the other partner's name.

stepresult.p: A short list of people appears under the box.

step.cmd: Choose the person from the list.

info.p: Typing is not enough. You must choose the name in the list.
Leave them empty if you do not know them.

stepresult.p: A row appears for one child. Choose under Existing person to pick someone who is in the tree. Or type a new name in the row.

step.cmd: For a new child, type the names, choose the sex, then choose for the birth date and the birthplace.

stepresult.p: A small window opens for each. Fill it in and choose .

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom and choose .

stepresult.p: The page of the family opens. It lists the partners, the marriage and the children.

result.p: Choose to see the family drawn out.

postreq.p: The page of the family also has and . Next: .
